subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Benevolent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Benevolent"** means showing kindness, goodwill, and a desire to do good to others. (दयालु, परोपकारी)

 
 
• **Example: **The benevolent teacher often helped her students in need without expecting anything in return.
 
 
 
• **"Malevolent"** refers to having or showing a wish to do evil or harm to others. (द्वेषपूर्ण, दुष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **His malevolent intentions were evident when he spread false rumors about his rival.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Benevolent'** is **'Malevolent'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Eminent** (प्रसिद्ध): Famous and respected within a particular sphere or profession.

 
 
• **Example:** He is an eminent scientist known for his groundbreaking research.
 
 
 
• **Violent** (हिंसक): Using physical force with the intent to harm or damage.
 
 
• **Example:** The protesters turned violent after their demands were ignored.
 
 
 
• **Opulent** (समृद्ध): Extremely wealthy and luxurious.
 
 
• **Example:** The palace was filled with opulent decorations and gold-plated furniture.
